title: Mint function `mekHoneyJarWithETH` will revert every time
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as there is an option to mint with ERC20 tokens too  **Likelihood:** High, as the function will just revert every time  ## Description  The `HoneyBox` contract exposes a way for users to mint `HoneyJar` NFTs with `ETH` in a public sale by the `mekHoneyJarWithETH` method. The problem is that the method uses `msg.value` to calculate the expected price, as the name suggest, that would have been paid with ETH, but the method is missing the `payable` keyword.
